cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I show you my dinner invitations, who did you authorize your sister to bring? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A date. Did you invite my ex?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Did you name anyone she couldn't bring? Then we'll get to my list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. My ex. I sent you both the same message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time did you send it to me? I'll put that beside my invitation's timestamp before we open it.

mechanism: A arranges a shared comparison of dinner invitations and B warning, giving B control of opening only after the warning time is stated.
confusable: Unlike simply hiding the guest list, A elicits what B forbade and when before exposing A own invitation.
comparison: Digital timestamps and an ex differ from fireworks scope and a delivery invoice.
seedUse: D184-b sister, ex and message; S02-b gives B the opening action while maintaining the statement-first sequence.
